title: Amethyst Axolotl
description: Replaces the rare blue axolotl with an amethyst axolotl
body:
This resource pack replaces the extremely rare **blue axolotl** with a custom **Amethyst Axolotl**. The new variant features soft purple tones and glowing violet accents, giving the creature a mystical appearance while still fitting naturally within the vanilla Minecraft style.

All other axolotl variants remain unchanged, so only the rare blue axolotl is replaced by this unique amethyst-colored version.
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72b6cd86b6368087ffb7b2084260af662fe112bc.png)
In addition, the **bucket containing a blue axolotl (1.21.5+)** has been updated to match the new appearance, featuring a corresponding amethyst axolotl inside the bucket.

![In bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b468f101aa1a70f1f129f7dd380864e513f5eb3f_0.webp)

If you are lucky enough to encounter the rare blue axolotl, you will instead discover this magical amethyst companion.

_The design is inspired by a skin created by kjizewa_
